s3.p1: When sharing data with partners, we always adhere to the following principles: Principle of legality: All cooperative activities involving data sharing must have a clear legal purpose and strictly comply with relevant laws and regulations. Principle of legitimacy and necessity: The sharing and use of data is limited to the minimum scope necessary to achieve legitimate purposes. Principle of security and prudence: When evaluating partners' data processing purposes and their security assurance capabilities, we will take a prudent attitude and require partners to strictly comply with the legal agreements reached between the two parties. For specific information about partners, please refer to our 《List of Third-Party Information Sharing》. In specific scenarios, such as entrusted processing or joint processing of personal information, we will sign legal agreements with the entrusted party or joint processor to clarify each party's rights and obligations and ensure the secure and compliant use of personal information.
s3.p2: As the business develops, we may be involved in mergers, acquisitions, or asset transfers, which may result in the transfer of your personal information. In such cases, we will ensure that the successor continues to fulfill personal information processing obligations in accordance with laws, regulations, and the standards of this Privacy Policy. If the successor intends to change the original processing purpose or method, we will require it to obtain your authorization anew.
s3.p3: We promise not to disclose your personal information arbitrarily unless we have obtained your explicit consent or are required to do so by laws and regulations. When disclosing personal information, we will adopt industry-standard security measures. However, in certain specific circumstances, such as penalizing accounts for violations or fraudulent behavior, we may disclose information about the relevant accounts.
s3.p4: Please note that in specific circumstances, in accordance with laws, regulations, and national standards, we may provide or disclose your personal information to partners without obtaining your prior authorization. These circumstances include, but are not limited to, what is necessary for contract performance, fulfillment of legal obligations, safeguarding national security, and responding to public health emergencies.
s3.title: 3. Data Sharing, Transfer, and Disclosure

s4.p1: In compliance with laws and regulations, we store your personal information within the territory of the People's Republic of China. At present, we do not transfer your information overseas. If cross-border transfer is involved in the future, we will strictly comply with relevant laws and regulations and seek your consent.
s4.p2: We will retain your personal information only for the period necessary to provide the services. After you cancel your account, proactively delete your personal information, or when the necessary period is exceeded, we will delete or anonymize your personal information. However, please note that in accordance with legal requirements or for purposes such as finance and auditing, we may need to extend the storage period of certain information.

s5.p1: We solemnly promise to treat the security of users' personal information as a top priority. To this end, we will take a series of reasonable and necessary security measures, including safeguarding against unauthorized use, unauthorized access, public disclosure, tampering, damage, loss, or leakage.
s5.p2: To ensure the security of user data, we will adopt industry-leading encryption technologies and anonymization measures. At the same time, we will deploy security protection mechanisms to defend against potential malicious attacks.
s5.p3: We have established a comprehensive security management system, including a professional security department and strict security management systems and processes. We only allow authorized personnel to access user data and conduct regular security audits to ensure compliance and security in data use.
s5.p4: Although we have taken many measures and complied with relevant legal requirements, limited by current technology and potential malicious behavior, we cannot guarantee one hundred percent security of information. Therefore, we strongly recommend that users strengthen their own information security awareness and take necessary measures to protect their personal accounts and passwords.
s5.p5: To respond to possible information security incidents, we have formulated detailed emergency plans. Once a security incident occurs, we will immediately activate the emergency response procedures, promptly notify users, and take corresponding remedial measures. We will maintain communication with users through push notifications, emails, letters, SMS, and other means, and report the handling situation as required by regulatory authorities when necessary.
s5.p6: Please note that when users leave the scope of our services to visit other websites or use other services, we will be unable to directly protect the personal information submitted by users on those platforms. Users are advised to handle their personal information with caution when using such services.
s5.title: 5. Personal Information Security Protection Measures

s4.p1: The Platform strictly complies with the 《Personal Information Protection Law》 and other relevant laws and regulations, adhering to the principles of minimum necessity, user authorization, and security assurance when collecting, using, and storing users' personal information, and at the same time protects users' legal rights to query, correct, delete, and withdraw authorization over their personal information.
s4.p2: Permission acquisition: This APP will request necessary system permissions from users (such as location, camera, microphone, contacts, storage, etc.) as required for function implementation. All permission requests are actively authorized by users. The Platform will not force users to authorize non-essential permissions. Users can withdraw or adjust authorizations at any time in the phone system or in the "Settings - Permission Management" within the APP.
s4.p3: Information collection: The Platform only collects personal information needed to realize the APP's functions, including but not limited to registered phone numbers, login passwords, identity authentication information, device information, and usage behavior data, and does not collect sensitive information unrelated to the functions.
s4.p4: Information use: Users' personal information is used only for function realization, service optimization, and security assurance of this APP, including but not limited to account login, transaction verification, customer service, and personalized recommendations. The Platform will not sell or rent users' personal information to any third party; if it is truly necessary to provide it to a third party, the Platform will conduct a compliance review of the third party, require it to assume information protection responsibilities, and inform the user and obtain consent in advance.
s4.p5: Information security: The Platform will adopt technical protective measures that meet industry standards (such as encrypted storage, access control, and data backup) to protect users' personal information security and prevent information leakage, tampering, and loss. If an information security incident occurs, the Platform will immediately take remedial measures and promptly notify users and report to regulatory authorities as required by relevant laws and regulations.
s4.p6: User information rights: Users can query, correct, and delete their own personal information through entries such as "Me - Settings - Account Management" in the APP, and can apply to cancel their account and request the Platform to delete relevant information (except where otherwise provided by laws and regulations). The Platform will process within 7 working days after receiving the user's application and provide feedback on the processing result.
s4.p7: Protection of minors' information: This APP will implement the relevant provisions on the protection of minors, strictly restrict the collection and use of minors' personal information, and prohibit displaying non-compliant content to minors or inducing minors to consume. If it is found that a minor uses the APP by borrowing an adult's information, the Platform may restrict the functionality available to them and contact the legal guardian for verification and handling.
s4.title: IV. Rules on Permissions and Use of Personal Information

Users should carefully read the relevant descriptions before paying, and the act of payment is deemed to constitute agreement to the usage rules of the item.

The Platform does not recognize transactions made through any unofficial payment channel, and users shall bear the losses caused by unofficial transactions themselves.
s5.p3: Refund policy: Virtual goods / services (such as memberships, recharged ZHIHUI credits, and online courses), once purchased, do not support no-reason refunds except where there are quality issues, platform failures, or otherwise provided by laws and regulations. If they cannot be used due to platform reasons, the Platform may arrange a refund or an equivalent service for the user. Physical goods follow the relevant provisions of the 《Consumer Rights Protection Law》 and support seven-day no-reason returns (except where otherwise provided by law). When returning, the goods must be kept intact, and the freight-bearing rules shall be executed in accordance with the agreement on the product detail page.
s5.p4: Refund application: Users can submit refund applications through entries such as "Me - Orders / Payment Records" in the APP. The Platform will review within 7 working days. After the review passes, the refund will be returned along the original payment path. The time for the refund to arrive shall be governed by the rules of the payment channel.
s5.p5: Transaction security: It is prohibited to use the transaction functions of this APP for fake transactions, cash-out, money laundering, and other non-compliant behaviors. The Platform may freeze and verify abnormal transactions. During the verification period, the relevant transaction functions will be suspended and restored after verification without error.
s5.p6: Asset protection: The recharged balance, ZHIHUI credits, virtual assets, coupons, etc. in users' accounts may only be used by the user personally and may not be transferred or withdrawn (except where otherwise agreed). After an account is frozen or canceled, unused assets will be handled in accordance with the relevant provisions of these rules. If an account is handled due to user violations, the assets will not be returned.

If a user fails to appeal within the time limit, the user is deemed to have accepted the Platform's violation handling decision, and the decision will formally take effect.
